newsitem.title: USA: Riscorp named in class action lawsuit.
newsitem.headline: Riscorp named in class action lawsuit.

text.p: Riscorp Inc has been named in a lawsuit filed on behalf of shareholders who bought stock between the company's initial public offering in February and November 14, 1996, lawyers for the plaintiffs said.

The suit filed in U.S. District Court for the Middle District of Florida claims that the company misrepresented material facts about its financial results, including the method of recognizing premiums, the attorneys said.
Riscorp was not immediately available for comment.
On November 14, 1996, the company said it had difficulty analysts' fourth quarter estimates.

Excluded from the class are the defendants and members of their immediate families, any entity in which a defendant has a controlling interest and the heirs of any such excluded party, the law firms said.
